reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Sentinece Life is top tier, no contest
reviews.text:

I’ve started 3 lives and still finding new paths. This is the new bar for the genre. 10/10.Sentinece Life

reviews.title: Peak
reviews.text:
Honestly this game has widely customizable features that I haven’t seen anywhere else before, I didn’t really think much of it when I first downloaded it thinking it was gonna be like some others (locked behind pay walls, vague, not a lot of variety) but it’s the exact opposite 🙏 

There is some features that you do have to pay for but it’s not much, the base game without paying has a vast range and would suffice if nothing else. 

The picking of personal aspects to your avatar and life are well thought and can make it feel more interesting and interactive, I can’t emphasize the variety enough though!

currently with the way this game is progressing with updates I think it can be the best simulation game for free/low cost passes. I would recommend playing and sharing it with other people. It’s like a hidden gem🙏

reviews.title: Gender prompts
reviews.text: The game is good, there's a lot to do, I like that the careers are more interactive than other life sims. The only downsides to this game is the use of generative ai for images (I like the image idea though), and the major con is that the gender prompts on everything is nonbinary. Even if the game recognizes that someone is male/female  the prompt will always read they/them instead of she/her or he/him. And, in a same sex couple (2 women) prompts will still recognize the partner as a dad instead of mom. I hope this is adjusted because it's a good, inclusive game aside from the ai.
